# kion_account_linkage (Resource)

Manages a Kion Account Linkage, associating an account with a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_account_linkage" "example" {
  # Required
  azure_object_id      = "example"
  azure_principal_name = "example"
  payer_id             = 1
  user_id              = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `azure_object_id` (String) Azure Object ID of the user (UUID format).
- `azure_principal_name` (String) Azure Principal Name (UPN) of the user.
- `payer_id` (Number) ID of the payer this linkage is associated with.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the Kion user to link.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account linkage ID.
